response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and cross-platform experience, there is minimal evidence of deep JVM, Java/Kotlin, or enterprise framework (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus) expertise required for this role; his work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only superficial Java exposure in early roles without context on IDE tooling or JVM internals.
strengths: Proven track record in building complex developer tooling and open-source projects
Strong background in cross-platform development and system-level performance optimization
Active contributor to testing frameworks and educational workshops on software engineering
concerns: No demonstrable experience with Spring, Hibernate, or other enterprise Java/Kotlin frameworks
Lack of documented work on IDE internals, language servers, or JVM tooling systems
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, with Java appearing only as a minor, outdated component

key_factors.factor: Absence of IDE or language tooling experience
